programs.title: Apache Drums
programs.desc: Stephen McNally stars as a gunslinger who gets slung out of town for gambling too well, but the town might just need him soon in Hugo Fregonese's visually arresting western.

programs.title: 3:10 to Yuma
programs.desc: Classic western with Glenn Ford and Van Heflin. The capture of a murderous stagecoach robber propels an impoverished local rancher on a perilous journey. Directed by Delmer Daves.

programs.title: The Major and the Minor
programs.desc: Ginger Rogers stars in this comedy of romantic misadventure. A woman poses as a girl to get a cheap rail fare. But things get awkward when she falls for a man who helps her out.

programs.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programs.desc: Fact-based crime biopic starring Robert Redford and Sissy Spacek. Charming 74-year-old bank robber Forrest Tucker falls for an enchanting farmer. But is he ready to retire.

programs.title: Bridge of Spies
programs.desc: Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance star in Steven Spielberg's Cold War spy drama. After gaining notoriety for defending a Soviet spy, a US lawyer then tries to free a CIA pilot.

programs.title: Bridge of Spies Interview Special
programs.desc: Director Steven Spielberg and stars Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance talk about making their Cold War espionage drama.

programs.title: Rescue Dawn
programs.desc: Werner Herzog's fact-based survival story stars Christian Bale as a US fighter pilot taken prisoner in Vietnam after being shot down during a top-secret mission.

programs.title: The Mission
programs.desc: Award-winning epic with Robert De Niro and Jeremy Irons. A Jesuit priest and a reformed slave trader forge an alliance to protect Indigenous South Americans from colonial Portugal.

programs.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programs.desc: Drama. Director Sam Wood's epic adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's classic story about the Spanish Civil War. Starring Oscar-nominees Gary Cooper and Ingrid Bergman.

programs.title: Battle at Apache Pass
programs.desc: Western. Apache chief Cochise is trying to keep the peace with the cavalry unit based at Fort Buchanan, but he's undermined by a government advisor and a rival Apache chief.
